name: keyword_compactor
description: Deterministic keyword-based tool-result compaction; uses cached intent when available and a bounded local fallback otherwise. Alternative to compactor — run ONE of the two; running after intent improves relevance.

permissions.name: env.cache_get
permissions.description: Read cached intents and canonical deterministic replacements

permissions.name: env.shared_cache_get
permissions.description: Read optional intent:<tool_call_id> values published by the intent plugin

permissions.name: ir.tool_results.write
permissions.description: Position-keyed tool-result text value changes (keyword compaction)
